name: Skype
description: Skype was Microsoft's consumer communications service for messaging, voice and video calls, contacts, and paid telephony. Microsoft retired Skype on May 5, 2025 and directed users to Microsoft Teams Free, while limited dial-pad and data-export transition paths remain separate non-API services.
agentUseSummary: Skype cannot be connected to Relay agents because the consumer product is retired and Microsoft publishes no supported consumer Skype OAuth, API-key, API, or remote MCP contract. Teams, Azure Communication Services, Skype for Business Server, the retired Skype Web SDK, export-portal automation, private endpoints, and browser automation are not Skype substitutes.

blocked.label: Connect a retired Skype service
blocked.description: Consumer Skype was retired on May 5, 2025 and has no supported third-party account connection contract.

blocked.label: Access Skype contacts, chats, or calls
blocked.description: Microsoft publishes no supported consumer Skype API for contacts, conversations, messages, presence, calls, numbers, or history.

blocked.label: Substitute a different Microsoft product
blocked.description: Microsoft Teams, Azure Communication Services, and on-premises Skype for Business Server are distinct products and cannot be represented as Skype.

blocked.label: Automate exports or private interfaces
blocked.description: The temporary user-facing export portal, retired SDKs, private endpoints, reverse engineering, and browser automation are not supported distributable Skype APIs.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled for the retired Skype consumer product without a supported production account API or remote MCP service.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported consumer Skype API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No supported consumer Skype API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Microsoft retired consumer Skype on May 5, 2025, retired Skype for Business Online on July 31, 2021, and retired the Skype Web SDK on September 30, 2024. Microsoft publishes no supported consumer Skype OAuth, API-key, API, or remote MCP contract for contacts, chats, messages, presence, calls, numbers, or history.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not show Connect, request Microsoft credentials, automate the temporary Skype Export Portal, or relabel Microsoft Teams, Azure Communication Services, or Skype for Business Server as Skype. Reconsider only if Microsoft publishes a supported consumer Skype production API or remote MCP service with an independently distributable third-party authorization contract.

evidence.supports: Microsoft states that Skype was retired on May 5, 2025 and directs consumer users to Microsoft Teams Free or a temporary data-export path.
Microsoft retired Skype for Business Online on July 31, 2021 and states that integrated services are no longer supported after retirement.
Microsoft retired the Skype Web SDK on September 30, 2024 and points developers to the distinct Azure Communication Services and Microsoft Graph products.
Microsoft documents a user-facing export portal for downloading Skype conversations and files; Relay does not treat that interactive transition path as a provider API.
